comment: Where the sung colour goes on a line with right-to-left text (src/bidi-highlight.ts and karaoke/bidi.py agree). Each stretch case: each word's pieces (left and right edges from the line's left edge, in logical word order), which words are lit, and the stretches drawn in the sung colour; null is beyond that end of the line. Each lit case: a line, how many leading non-space characters are sung, and which words are lit.
